Fields copied from the property examples of components/schemas/Video and VideoChannel in PeerTube’s published OpenAPI document. Nested fields with no example are omitted.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chocobozzz/PeerTube/3f04da2213316eebe6a280a7c7f37fba356e41a6/support/doc/api/openapi.yaml

channels_response.json and videos_response.json are verbatim complete response examples from https://docs.joinpeertube.org/api-rest-reference/api/video-channels.html and https://docs.joinpeertube.org/api-rest-reference/api/video.html respectively.

my_account_response.json is the complete published response from https://docs.joinpeertube.org/api-rest-reference/api/my-user.html.
